_: Who speaks how (tools/make_voices.py): a description for Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign (once per figure and language, then cloned for every line) and effects after the voice: machine (a soft metal comb), shimmer (the Curator's even calm), chorus (the Choir: several voices at once), pa (a loudspeaker), radio (added by the game's radio calls in flight for everyone without an effect of their own). data/speakers.txt says which story speaker has which voice.

orrin.describe: A calm, precise male voice in his forties, warm mid-baritone, exact articulation, dry understated wit, quietly protective; the on-board mind of a fighter craft, never hurried.

quill.describe: A chatty, warm man in his fifties, a smuggler and trader, lively tenor-baritone with a grin in the voice, quick pace, theatrical salesman flourishes, slightly hoarse from talking too much.

okonjo.describe: A brilliant, tired woman in her early sixties, an engineer and scientist, low warm alto, thoughtful and precise, quiet guilt and steady resolve, measured pace.

salgado.describe: A weathered sea captain in his mid-forties who leads fishers and dock workers, rough strong baritone, direct and warm-hearted, used to shouting over wind and waves.

voss.describe: A cold, formal admiral in his late fifties, clipped precise baritone, completely controlled, never raises his voice, quietly menacing authority.

curator.describe: A calm, polite, gentle male voice, perfectly even and soft, unsettlingly kind, slow measured pace, like a patient museum guide explaining something obvious.

choir.describe: A soft, breathy, otherworldly voice, slow and dreamy, gentle and ancient, speaking in images, almost whispering.

vey.describe: A woman test pilot in her early thirties, dry and stubborn, few words, cool clear mid-range voice, slightly husky, calm under pressure.

tosk.describe: A forewoman of a mining cooperative in her fifties, firm earthy alto, blunt and practical, a hint of humour.

krenn.describe: A woman officer, a major in her forties, crisp disciplined alto, military clarity, restrained and correct.

halvard.describe: A woman ship captain in her fifties, calm commanding mezzo-soprano, steady and a little weary.

man.describe: A man in his thirties with a deep male voice, an ordinary dock worker, clear low baritone, earnest, clearly male.

man2.describe: A man in his fifties with a low gravelly male voice, a weathered miner, rough baritone, a little nervous and hurried, clearly male.

woman.describe: A woman in her thirties, clear warm mezzo-soprano, natural and direct.

woman2.describe: A young woman in her twenties, bright quick voice, a little breathless.

oldman.describe: A very old man, thin and slightly cracked voice, slow and wise, gentle.

child.describe: A child of about eight years, bright high voice, earnest and a little shy.

announcer.describe: A neutral automated female announcement voice, perfectly even and friendly, very clear, calm synthetic politeness.

officer.describe: A formal male military officer in his forties, clipped bureaucratic baritone, emotionless and correct.

narrator.describe: A warm, calm narrator, a woman in her forties, soft low mezzo-soprano, unhurried documentary tone.
